why: The judged answer to every entry in tests/ownership.generated.json's `consistency` section: a test whose directory names one owner while its imports reach another. D116 §四 keeps both answers and unions them, so nothing here changes what runs — the test still runs for either owner's change. What an entry says is that the reach was looked at and is the means rather than the subject: a compiler test that loads the Web extension to have an extension to compile under, a Core test that runs a Node probe project to run a program at all. A finding with no entry here is red, and an entry for a finding that no longer exists, or for an owner a file no longer reaches, is red too — the list is a record of judgments, not a drawer. Moving the file is the better answer whenever the reach is the subject; that is what this list is not for.
